messages:
marta: Quick sync 10: EdgeWave marketplace goes live next Tue. We need a concise partner SEV lifeline doc and owners today.
leo: +1. Suggested policy: shared Slack channel only for SEV1 (customer-facing outage). SEV2 uses ephemeral warroom links or private threads and invite partner liaisons as needed.
priya: I'll gather EdgeWave POCs and preferred Slack scopes (read/post). Will also prepare whitelist spreadsheet.
sam: Automation plan: `/warroom create edgewave --type=shared --ttl=72h` creates #edgewave-sev-warroom, invites whitelisted emails, and posts starter template. If it fails, bot posts BRIDGE_FAILED and pages eng-sre.
ops-bot: warroom created: #edgewave-sev-warroom (expires in 72h)  invites sent to edgewave-poc@edgewave.com
tina: Severity defs proposal: SEV1 = outage or data loss for paying customers; SEV2 = degraded performance impacting >10% traffic or key merchants, workaround exists.
marta: Pasteable SEV1 runbook (use in warroom):
1) Confirm severity and impacted tenants.
2) `infra show partner=edgewave` for topology.
3) `/warroom create edgewave --type=shared`
4) Page @eng-sre on-call: `pagerduty: SEV1 edgewave`
5) Post starter: "SEV1 declared. Impact X%. Leads: @sam (SRE), @priya (Partner Success), @tina (Support). ETA first update: 10m. Logs: <sanitized link>."
sam: Fallback: if shared channel provisioning blocked, create private warroom, generate invite link, start Zoom via bot, and escalate to partner workspace DM if needed. Bot will auto-page on BRIDGE_FAILED.
priya: Comms gate: no external customer-facing notice without PS + Sales signoff. Partner Success owns templates.
leo: Ops checklist to pin: one-line impact, actions taken, next owner + ETA, and explicit handoff marker when resolved.
marta: Owners: Priya (POCs + whitelist + comms), Sam (automation + bot), Tina (support runbook + training), Leo (severity doc). We'll run a 15-min dry run Fri. Thanks :thumbsup:
